_note: Closed source lists per lane. Agents may only search and fetch these domains; subdomains of a listed domain are allowed. Locked on 2026-10-18 from a probe of 86 candidate domains with three real rail suppliers (Knorr-Bremse, Wabtec, Vossloh): config/source_probe_results.json. A domain is kept when its page text can be extracted (basic or advanced) and it either returned relevant hits for the test companies (news, company) or is a primary list, regulator, court or register (legal, science), where no hits is expected for companies that are not sanctioned or investigated. tier 1 = primary (regulator, court, register, official list, the company itself); tier 2 = established trade press, wire or broadcaster; tier 3 = aggregator or encyclopedia, which never counts as the only source for a high-severity claim. `structured` sources are lists and APIs that code reads directly, not pages an agent searches. Dropped after reading real pages: finance.yahoo.com and marketscreener.com. Their extracted pages were mostly menus, paywall text ("Enter your password", "Upgrade to unlock") and ticker tables, with almost no article text.
